validity_findings.finding: All fingerprint sets are deterministic (1 unique value per state per source, effective distinct N=1 per state despite nominal N=20). Bootstrap CIs are degenerate [1.0,1.0] or [0.0,0.0] as expected per prereg section 6. Not inferential precision.

validity_findings.finding: Measurement is bounded to localhost Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT 2.14.0 HS256 + SQLite WAL on Werkzeug 3.1.8 Python 3.12.14 at 127.0.0.1:19849, single sequential client, jitter 50-150ms with no observable effect on deterministic fingerprints, Connection: close constant. No concurrency, TLS/HTTP2, production WSGI (gunicorn/nginx), CDN, load balancer, or distributed SQLite replication tested. Producer correctly discloses this and retains EXPERIMENTAL ceiling (no VALIDATED/PRODUCT_CORE promotion).

Effective body lengths are 31/70/117 bytes (B=70, C=117) not ~52/~95 prose approximations in spec Table 4.2. The frozen spec explicitly marks them '~52'/'~95 (exact logged)' and C6 requires only strict inequality and proportionality via Content-Length==body_len, all of which hold (31<70<117). Body A pin exact (31 B, SHA d0ca833f843c...) recomputed and verified. Not a protocol violation; disclosed.

Producer corrected server error-body mapping before any full measurement (smoke showed 401 body session_invalid vs frozen pin unauthorized). Correction to frozen constant error bodies (403 forbiden 22B SHA 387fe7..., 401 unauthorized 25B SHA 9df366...) was made before full run, smoke re-passed, no measurement taken with non-conforming body. This is implementation alignment to frozen spec, not post-hoc weakening of decision rule. Disclosed in report.md section 7 and result.json validity_notes[7].

Raw line count 300 (15 batches x20) exceeds prereg prose 140-180 but matches frozen spec null_control which mandates N3 same-state 403 resampled and same-state 401 resampled (perm403_null_1/2, sess401_null_1/2) plus exploratory N2. C7/C8 require those nulls. Batch_state_log 27 lines (12 writes +15 pre-batch verifies) is consistent. Disclosed as nominal vs effective N per prereg section 11.

Date header varied across observations and was correctly excluded; Server constant and excluded; X-Request-Id absent. Filtered headers contain only Cache-Control, Connection, Content-Length, Content-Type, ETag, Vary. Verified 0 leakage into fingerprint_filtered dicts on recomputed sample (15 checked, all raw).

Status identity (all body-only and null batches 200 vs 200), body SHA distinct across A/B/C (d0ca83..., 67c186..., b46c46... each 1 value), Content-Length==body_len on all 300 observations, CLEN distinct 31/70/117 strictly increasing, non-CLEN headers identical across A/B/C (Cache-Control max-age=3600, ETag W/fixed-aaa-111, Vary Accept-Encoding, no Set-Cookie), Set-Cookie absent 0/300 on body-only states. Recomputed from raw_observations.jsonl matches producer identity_checks.

Body discrimination tested at only 3 magnitudes (31,70,117 bytes, 1-6 JSON fields). All comparisons hit ceiling 1.0, so no sensitivity gradient or per-field ordering measured. Producer discloses this as unresolved and does not claim graded sensitivity.

claim_ceiling: HTTP fingerprint substrate hash(status_code || body_bytes || sorted_filtered_standard_headers) with EXCLUDED_HEADERS={Date,Server,X-Request-Id} deterministically discriminates same-status body-only drift (200 vs 200, bodies byte-different via committed SQLite body_config/content_variant write, Content-Length varies 31 vs 70 vs 117 proportional to body_len, non-Content-Length filtered headers identical) on localhost Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT 2.14.0 HS256 + SQLite WAL (Werkzeug 3.1.8, Python 3.12.14, 127.0.0.1:19849, SEED 44, nominal N=20 per batch effective distinct N=1 deterministic, degenerate bootstrap CI [1.0,1.0]/[0.0,0.0]): full-vector Jaccard 1.0 >0.5, body-only 1.0 >0.5 on A vs C and A vs B, status-only 0.0, headers-no-CLEN 0.0, headers-only 1.0 via body-correlated Content-Length, full strictly exceeds status (1.0 > 0.0 complementary to parent header-only 1.0>0.0). Writable controls perm escalation 403 vs 200 and session invalidation 401 vs 200 achieve >=0.7 (observed 1.0) with nulls FP 0.0 <0.05. Completes localhost C-MEAS-VALID matrix (header-only + same-status body-only + status-varying maximally-distinct + null stability) for this synthetic testbed. Does NOT extend to production WSGI (gunicorn/nginx), CDN, distributed session replication, concurrency, HTTP/2/TLS, or sensitivity ordering (ceiling 1.0). Remains EXPERIMENTAL; not VALIDATED or PRODUCT_CORE.
